title: AWS IAM extends trusted identity propagation to IAM federation and IAM Roles Anywhere, and simplifies it in IAM Identity Center
summary: Discover more about what's new at AWS with AWS IAM extends trusted identity propagation to IAM federation and IAM Roles Anywhere, and simplifies it in IAM Identity Center
body_markdown:
[Trusted identity propagation (TIP)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/trustedidentitypropagation-overview.html) carries the identity of a human user or workload with requests to supported AWS Services. Customers can use that identity in IAM policy conditions for access control and to identify the originating human user or workload in AWS CloudTrail. AWS is expanding TIP to[AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) federation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_providers.html#id_roles_providers_federation) and[IAM Roles Anywhere](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/rolesanywhere/latest/userguide/introduction.html) , while simplifying the existing TIP experience in AWS IAM Identity Center. In addition,[IAM outbound identity federation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_providers_outbound.html) now enables customers to request an AWS-signed JSON Web Token (JWT) that includes identity information from TIP sessions, allowing external services to identify the human user or workload that originated the request.


With TIP for IAM federation, customers can map the human or workload identity, along with optional runtime claims such as a risk score or a CI/CD workflow name, from the SAML assertion or OIDC token used for federation to the role session. IAM Roles Anywhere extends TIP to identities sourced from X.509 certificates. For IAM Identity Center, which supports workforce identities, the simplified experience adds the username, an identifier provided by your identity source, alongside the user ID that IAM Identity Center generates, and carries this information uniformly whether users access applications or AWS accounts. Across all supported paths, TIP preserves identity information as requests move between IAM roles and AWS services without requiring per-role trust policy updates.


TIP for IAM federation, IAM Roles Anywhere, IAM outbound identity federation, and the simplified IAM Identity Center experience are available in all commercial AWS Regions, the AWS GovCloud (US) Regions, and the AWS European Sovereign Cloud (Germany) Region. To get started, see the[Trusted Identity Propagation for IAM documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_providers_tip.html) ,[Trusted Identity Propagation in IAM Identity Center documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/simplified-tip-overview.html) , and the[TIP launch blog](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/security/know-the-identity-behind-the-role-authorize-and-audit-with-trusted-identity-propagation/) .
